credit: Rustic ironberry fruit (Dynamic Trees tree-pack fruit block). Same reasoning as rustic:block/olives: Dynamic Trees registers rustic:ironberries at runtime and ships no asset for it, so the render model is authored here to replace the missing-texture cube fallback. The legacy ironberry cluster sprite is drawn as a cutout cross; the four growth ages share this one model (per-age collision is driven by trees/rustic/fruits/ironberries.json block_shapes).
